The remainder team in `getAllTeams()` now only collects active unmatched contributors. The change is one condition in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java` (around line 747):

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

- **Configured teams:** unchanged. The team-matching loop runs before this check, so their members are kept whether active or not.
- **Blank latest-commit date:** `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date, so these contributors count as active and are kept.
- **Tests:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` compiles and passes. No existing test covers `getAllTeams()`, so the new filter has no dedicated test. I did not add one.
- **Not committed.**
